node.statement: Same-output packaging. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, the extended isomorphism v is bijective, so define u=v^(-1):A->B. Form one datum S over the already fixed W_RF with exactly the displayed H,Phi,eta,B,v,u, the canonical tilde-Phi,A,star,r,epsilon_AI(eta), and the notation tilde-Delta=iota_{A subseteq B(H)} composed with v and tilde-Upsilon=u composed with tilde-Phi, as prescribed by def-routef-raw-factor-setting. All fields are well typed, and the conclusions attached to S are precisely tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi, the extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra structure, the extended C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)-isomorphism v, and 0<=epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta<=epsilon_E established above; none is inferred merely from the data definition.
